results.result_reasoning: Claims C1–C4 consistently describe the document as a correction to a study on gait parameters in wild type and sensory deprived Drosophila melanogaster. These claims are directly supported by the title and are internally consistent. However, this is metadata about the document, not a scientific result from experimental work.

Claims C5–C9 list the authors and identify Richard S Mann as the corresponding author. These are straightforward factual statements directly supported by the author list provided in the manuscript. Like R1, this represents document metadata rather than a scientific finding.
